positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (40.5): 2.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 155 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dakota MRT about 350 m, Paya Lebar MRT about 570 m; closer than 478 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 250 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 12 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 350 m), more than 593 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall about 650 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,110 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Old Airport Road Food Centre And Shopping Mall

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 400 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 530 m; Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 850 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 970 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,140 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,140 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,370 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,490 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 405 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 473 new sales and 989 resales (1,462 purchases); new sales were 32.4% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 989 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 553 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 989 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,148 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.9%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
